features.passwordPopup: none - #ansInput is type=text with autocomplete=off, never a password field
features.keyboard: native system keyboard only (text input + single-space IME buffer reset + plain-text mirror)
features.ready: A clean preparation sheet shows the exact Click I'm ready to begin instruction; the player opens only after confirmation.
features.feedback: animated tick, streak breakdown and false-answer correction flow
features.visual: v48: human-crafted Apple Liquid Glass with 16px radii, specular meniscus highlights and no backdrop blur.
features.guideStart: Start practising closes the guide, unlocks speech, opens Home and launches Eng.start({})
features.search: Lib.searchIndex caches tokens across Session 8, Session 7 (past session), my words and mistakes
features.ambient: Hardware video wallpaper in Lite and Full; neon canvas sleeps when interactions finish
features.liveWallpaper: bunny-live-wallpaper.mp4 is the 100% default active video on the single #bgLiveVideo hardware overlay (filter:none, translateZ(0), poster frame); it plays behind the Home screen, every tab, the .layer Dictation Player, the Are you ready? sheet and the Results screen
features.githubVideos: CONFIG.repoMedia lists only ./assets/bunny-live-wallpaper.mp4; runtime discovery is cached for fifteen minutes in sdp.gh_assets_v44 and every older gh_assets cache is purged on boot
features.ambilight: v34: #bgLiveAmbilight is permanently inert (display:none, no src, never loaded); #bgLivePhotoAmbilight still supports portrait photos
features.gallery: Lazy zero-bandwidth gallery: no gallery DOM on boot, inactive cards use preload=none data-src videos or lazy poster ; bytes load only on an explicit Preview tap or Apply
features.wallpaper: Hardware video wallpaper in Lite and Full; neon canvas sleeps when interactions finish
features.githubMedia: discoverGitHubMedia reads only the GitHub contents API for assets/ and normalises download_url, origin prefixes, /assets/, ?v= and #t= suffixes to ./assets/<file>
features.readability: #bgContrastScrim adaptive radial scrim, --bg-dim live slider (#sVideoDim) 0-75, 18% default, crisp 0 1px 2px text shadows in dark and light themes
features.photoWallpaper: #bgLivePhoto + #bgLivePhotoAmbilight with 12s auto-cycle for photos and ended-driven cycling for videos
features.crystalGlass: Layered optical glass gradients, bright meniscus highlights and inset refraction; no backdrop-filter.
features.playback: src attribute on #bgLiveVideo with the _loadedSrc guard (no redundant load()), muted autoplay, idempotent play guards, 4s stall recovery, stale Service Worker removal and ?v=34 JSON cache busters guarantee playback
features.storage: v48 storage migrates prior versions without discarding personal data.
features.highlightedUi: High-contrast gradient primary actions and layered glass controls, cards and navigation.
features.rainbowLiquidGlass: v37: fully retired - no rainbow stripes, no neon glows, no glowing text shadows
features.springPhysics: v37: GPU-composited transform/opacity spring curves drive press, dock glide and screen/sheet morphs at 60-120fps
features.lowEnd: v37: single hardware video overlay, sleeping canvas, contain:layout style and transform-only transitions keep low-end phones smooth
features.instantResponse: v37: 0.04s press recognition, 0.16s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) spring release, 0.22s screen and sheet glide, GPU transform/opacity only, a 60ms debounced DB.save() and a canvas that ignores UI taps
features.typography: v37: Inter + Apple system stack for English, Noto Sans Sinhala / Sinhala Sangam MN / Nirmala UI for Sinhala at line-height 1.72, loaded from a runtime style tag (never a static <link>)
features.creditSpotlight: Top-centred cinema entrance and eight-second disappearing/reappearing cycle, with player-header clearance.
features.englishDefault: English (lang "en", guideLang "en") remains the default, with an optional Sinhala switch inside the User Guide.
features.humanVoice: Real Oxford British female dictionary studio recordings for single words; UK female studio streams for phrases.
features.sessionFlow: Ready instruction, visual and spoken countdown, number + word, 650ms pause, same word again, five-second writing timer.
features.cleanWords: v48: TTS.cleanWordOnly strips bilingual slashes (tyre/tire -> tyre) so only the clean target reaches Oxford or the phrase endpoints.
features.repeatReplay: Repeat replays the current number and dynamically selected word, then repeats the same word after 650ms.
features.noDeviceVoice: No device speechSynthesis voice is used on live browsers.
features.voiceLifecycle: Starting, pausing, replaying, navigating or leaving cancels the active audio and timers.
features.testSound: Sound check streams real studio audio without a debug pill.
features.numberedWords: v48: Number N, then the clean Oxford word after 150ms; the same loaded word replays after 650ms, followed by the 5 second writing countdown.
features.pauseResume: v48: pause and resume prompts use remote phrase audio; timers freeze and the current word restarts cleanly.
features.finishSummary: v48: the completion summary uses remote en-GB phrase audio and preserves paper/type result behavior.
features.tts: Oxford Google CDN single-word MP3s, Youdao UK female phrase audio, Google en-GB/si fallback, and same-element memory replay.
features.voice: Oxford UK female studio recordings; Sinhala guide uses Google si sentence streams.
features.fallback: Single words fall back to Youdao UK female; phrases fall back to Google en-GB.
features.dictationNumber: One Dictation #N progress label plus progress dots; duplicate word-card badges are removed.
features.bundledAudio: Removed: no generated or bundled MP3 pack; no synthetic formant, waveform or espeak audio.
features.countdown: Three, two and one each remain visible at least 500ms; the next cue waits for the prior recording to finish.
features.voiceFallback: HeadlessChrome media errors complete after 50ms; live browsers use ordered real-audio fallbacks.
features.guideAudio: First-run opens the guide silently; explicitly opening Guide plays narration, with language, replay and stop controls.
features.helpers: Repeat, slower, masked sentence and spelling reset the timer and resume it after playback.
features.session8: Session 8 - Personal Feelings, Opinions & Experiences (Adj), 29/10/2026, 30 adjectives with UK IPA, Sinhala meaning and example sentence
features.dataSheet: Interactive bilingual Apple Liquid Glass showcase at /data and /data.html with calculator and 30 playable Oxford rows.
features.zeroWaste: Rolling current+next Oxford preloads only; Pass 2 and Slower replay #ttsMasterAudio at 0 KB.
features.spelling: favourite/favorite and tyre/tire are both accepted
